description_zh: 调用DescribeCustomMetricList接口查询上报的自定义监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-custom-metric-list --group-id 73780000 --metric-name cpu_total --dimension sampleName1=value1_amp_sampleName2=value2 --md5 97c25982d9745a231276bff274690000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCustomMetricList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application group.

For information about how to query the IDs of application groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组ID。

关于如何获取应用分组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom metric
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The dimensions based on which the resources are queried
parameters.help_zh: 维度Map，用于查询指定资源的监控数据。
parameters.name: dimension

parameters.help_en: The MD5 value of the HTTP request body. The MD5 value is a 128-bit hash value used to verify the uniqueness of the reported monitoring data
parameters.help_zh: 消息摘要算法，可以产生一个128位（16字节）的散列值，用来校验上报的自定义监控数据的唯一性
parameters.name: md5

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

Code.description_en:
The responses code.

The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Result.description_en: The reported custom metrics that are found in the query
Result.description_zh: 自定义监控数据查询结果
